_about: Draft /ask API contract for Group 7 chatbot (Ethan <-> Ahmed, agree by 24 Oct). Example data only: URLs, places and the wellbeing wording are placeholders, not real SHU content.

body.question: How do I reset my university password?

request.rules: question must be a non-empty string, max 500 characters

body.answer: Plain-English answer written only from the saved SHU pages.
I couldn't find that in the SHU pages I have. Try contacting Student Support directly.
Here are some places near City Campus.
[Fixed wellbeing message - wording to be copied from the SHU wellbeing page, Ahmed to confirm]

rate_limited.body: Returned by Nginx, not Flask - may be HTML, so the page should show a generic 'too many requests, try again shortly' message.

body.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

field_notes.answer: string - always present on 200. Insert with textContent, not innerHTML.
field_notes.sources: list of {title, url} - empty when unanswered, a places question, or safety triggered
field_notes.places: list of {name, type, distance_m, map_url} - empty unless the question is about local food/coffee/shops
field_notes.safety: bool - true means the model was skipped and answer is the fixed wellbeing message; the page may want to style it differently
field_notes.time_ms: int - server-side time, logged for the test spreadsheet

safety_and_places_functions.safety.py: check(question: str) -> str | None  (returns the fixed message if triggered, else None)
safety_and_places_functions.places.py: lookup(question: str) -> list[dict] | None  (returns places for local questions, else None)
safety_and_places_functions.note: Proposed signatures - Ahmed to confirm. /ask calls safety first and returns immediately if it triggers.
